Image alt: A simple drawn image of a man on a bright yellow background is seen. Four Asian characters are seen across the top. He has slanted, almond shaped eyes, large eyebrows, a moustache and goatee, and black hair is seen under his hat, which has wings sticking out each side. He wears a robe and his hands are tucked in the opposite sleeves of his robe.
